content: NEO-6M/NEO-M8N support interleaved NMEA+UBX on the same UART. UBX binary protocol is required to configure update rate (e.g. 4-10Hz), disable unneeded NMEA sentences (keep only RMC+GGA), and access power-save modes (UBX-CFG-RXM cyclic tracking on NEO-6M; UBX-CFG-PMS/PM2 on M8-series). Config can be saved to the module's battery-backed config (NEO-6M) or flash (M8N) so it persists across power cycles.
